inputs.text: {"high_level_description": "Empty Bloodridge sunken crypt battle stage at dusk, rendered entirely in crisp, deliberately clustered pixel art. Bold clean storybook shapes like a fantasy strategy game, chunky readable stones, warm saturated sandstone and mossy green on the ruins and roots, lit at dusk: a burnt orange sky low on the horizon, cold violet blue shadows, two torches burning beside the crypt doorway throwing warm orange light on the steps and pillars, the doorway pitch dark. Moody 1980s dark fantasy film light. One single continuous 2.5D battle scene, no figures, no text.", "style_description": {"medium": "pixel_art", "art_style": "Authentic hand-pixelled 2D game background. Visible square pixel clusters and stair-stepped contours everywhere. Muted limited palette, flat colour clusters, two or three discrete shades per stone. Organic uneven shapes with carefully chipped corners. Broad quiet surfaces with occasional short angular cracks. Crisp pixel edges without antialiasing. The controlled pixel craft of an old burial court: irregular broad paving stones, shallow angular shadows, weathering only on selected edges. No paint brushwork, no gritty texture layer, no dithering, no gradients.", "aesthetics": "readable 2.5D battle stage, bold storybook shapes, 1980s dark fantasy film dusk, coherent pixel clusters", "lighting": "Cool violet ambient light under a burnt orange sky, two warm torch pools at the doorway, as discrete flat pixel colour planes. The fighting ground in calm even dusk light, still readable.", "color_palette": ["#1e1830", "#3a2e4e", "#5e4a6a", "#8a5a48", "#c07a48", "#e8a050", "#ffd27a", "#6f7a3a", "#a8b060", "#d8a46a"]}, "compositional_deconstruction": {"background": "One continuous 2.5D side view battle stage seen from a fixed oblique camera, no figures. The upper part: the sunken crypt of Bloodridge, a ruined stone crypt doorway in the middle with heavy pillars, a broken lintel and two worn steps, its inside dark; rubble terraces and broken stairs on the left; an old wall gripped by huge twisting tree roots on the right; above them a strip of dusk sky over a distant ridge. The lower half: one wide flat courtyard of broad worn paving stones, quiet and even so small fighters read on it.", "elements": [{"type": "obj", "bbox": [0, 300, 380, 660], "desc": "the ruined stone crypt doorway with heavy pillars, a broken lintel and two worn steps, pitch dark inside, a burning torch on each side"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [40, 0, 360, 310], "desc": "rubble terraces and broken stone stairs with moss"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [30, 640, 400, 1000], "desc": "an old stone wall gripped by huge twisting mossy tree roots"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [380, 0, 1000, 1000], "desc": "a wide flat courtyard of broad worn paving stones in calm even dusk light"}]}}
